topic: Electron Dot Diagrams and Periodic Table Groups
key_concepts: Electron dot diagrams show valence electrons as dots around an element symbol.
Valence electrons determine how elements are represented in electron dot diagrams.
The periodic table is organized into s, p, d, and f blocks.
Elements in the s-block have their outermost electrons in an s orbital.
The p-block spans six groups because p orbitals can hold up to six electrons.
The d-block spans ten groups because d orbitals can hold up to ten electrons.
The f-block has 14 elements in a series because f orbitals can hold up to 14 electrons.
